meta.title: Real Estate
meta.description: Housing market analysis and estate planning: what the data says and how wealth passes between generations.
meta.note: Add a post here once; blogs/real_estate.html renders the archive, topic and year filters, and search from this list via /blogs/archive.js. Optional meta.tagPages entries build a tag listing (for example /blogs/real_estate/tips.html) and turn matching tag pills into links. Rebuild hubs, the tag page, and article pills with: python3 tools/build_blog_hubs.py

tagPages.label: Real Estate Tips
tagPages.description: Practical notes for buyers who want to see past staging and finishes: hidden square footage, the bones of a house, and what different construction years tend to hide — or leave behind.

posts.title: The Listing Said 1,840 Square Feet. The Basement Wasn't in It.
posts.desc: A fictional buyer near retirement walks a house with an unfinished basement and attic. What hidden square footage actually requires — ceiling height, egress, moisture, permits — and how to read a published cost-versus-value figure.
posts.imageAlt: An unfinished basement with sage-painted joists, a wood staircase, a concrete floor, and a wide window looking onto a green lawn

posts.title: The House Looked Tired. The Ceilings Did Not.
posts.desc: A fictional buyer near retirement walks a tired house and looks first at high ceilings, layout, light and the lot — the bones that paint cannot invent, and the repairs that are usually cheap or expensive to fix.
posts.imageAlt: A slightly weathered sage-green two-story house with a wide porch, tall windows, and an overgrown but leafy front garden

posts.title: The Carpet Came Up. The Oak Was Still There.
posts.desc: A fictional buyer near retirement tours a 1968 ranch and finds hardwood under wall-to-wall carpet and a forgotten central-vacuum inlet — plus the era red flags EPA and CPSC actually documented, from lead paint to aluminum wiring.
posts.imageAlt: A corner of beige carpet folded back from oak hardwood floors in a sage-green room, with a small circular inlet on the baseboard

posts.title: Two Acres Looked the Same. Only One Was Two Lots.
posts.desc: Two fictional buyers near retirement each consider a two-acre listing advertised as more than one lot. Legal lots, merger rules, wetlands, costs and a walk-away — a diligence story, not a return promise.
posts.imageAlt: A wooden fence dividing a green meadow, with a small white house on a distant hill

posts.title: The Buyer's Market With No Buyers
posts.desc: Redfin counts a record 62.6% more sellers than buyers in September 2026, yet buying has rarely been harder. What the gap really measures: mortgage rates, lock-in and the renters waiting on the sidelines.
posts.imageAlt: A quiet sage-green suburban house with a freshly mowed lawn and mature trees

posts.title: The SECURE Act 2.0 & Inherited IRAs: 10-Year Rule Mechanics
posts.desc: How SECURE Act 2.0 and the 10-year rule reshape inherited IRA distributions and generational wealth transfers. Educational only.
posts.imageAlt: A Last Will and Testament document on a desk
